runtime.security_impact: Defines the language/runtime environment. Deprecated or unsupported runtimes may have unpatched vulnerabilities.
runtime.rationale: Ensure only actively supported runtimes are used to avoid CVEs.

deployment.description: Code and application artifacts that make up this version.
deployment.security_impact: Improper deployment packaging may include sensitive files or expose unnecessary binaries.
deployment.compliant: Deployment includes only signed application zip bundle.
deployment.non-compliant: Deployment bundle includes unused debug files or credentials.

entrypoint.security_impact: Improper entrypoint may bypass authentication logic or allow arbitrary execution.
entrypoint.rationale: Entrypoint should be minimal and verified to enforce application logic.

service.security_impact: Improperly named services can lead to routing confusion or expose unintended workloads.
service.rationale: Separate services logically for clearer security boundaries.

service_account.description: The identity that the deployed version will run as.
service_account.security_impact: Service account defines runtime permissions. Using broad roles (Editor/Owner) risks privilege escalation.
service_account.rationale: Always run with least-privilege service accounts.
service_account.non-compliant: service_account = default App Engine service account with Editor.

handlers.security_impact: Handlers enforce HTTPS and login. Misconfiguration may expose sensitive endpoints over HTTP.
handlers.rationale: All admin or internal routes should require authentication and HTTPS.

env_variables.description: Environment variables available to the app.
env_variables.security_impact: Storing secrets in plain environment variables risks leakage.
env_variables.rationale: Use Secret Manager for sensitive keys.

vpc_access_connector.description: Enables VPC connectivity for standard apps.
vpc_access_connector.security_impact: Without VPC connector, app traffic may traverse public internet.
vpc_access_connector.rationale: Use VPC connectors for private service access.
vpc_access_connector.non-compliant: Omitting VPC connector for sensitive apps.

automatic_scaling.security_impact: Improper scaling may exhaust resources or expose app to denial-of-service.
automatic_scaling.rationale: Set sane min/max instances and latency thresholds.

basic_scaling.security_impact: Improper idle timeouts may keep unnecessary instances alive, wasting resources.
basic_scaling.rationale: Use small idle_timeout for non-critical workloads.
basic_scaling.non-compliant: idle_timeout left default, keeping idle instances indefinitely.

manual_scaling.security_impact: Running continuous instances unnecessarily increases attack surface.
manual_scaling.rationale: Use manual scaling only when workload requires persistent memory/state.

libraries.security_impact: Unpinned or outdated libraries may include vulnerabilities.
libraries.rationale: Pin library versions and update regularly.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.security_impact: Explicit scoping avoids accidental deployment into wrong projects.
project.rationale: Always define project ID for clarity.
project.non-compliant: Omitting project, relying on provider defaults.
